prompt.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: a THREE-FRAME limited-animation key-pose SPRITE SHEET of this exact Song dynasty village woman offering a flat round basket of fresh greens, standing on a field road, turned toward the LEFT of the image. TWO reference images. The FIRST shows the exact woman to draw: copy identity, face, hair, clothing colours and carried objects from it. Its camera angle is from slightly above and partly from behind; IGNORE that angle. The SECOND reference is a finished three-cell sheet of a different person: copy ONLY its camera angle (eye-level three-quarter view, the same as every other figure on the street), its figure scale and its three-cell layout. Do NOT copy that person. Keep her identity: black hair in a bun tied with a rust-red ribbon, sage-green cross-collar jacket, cream apron, rust-red long skirt, dark shoes, the SAME shallow round woven basket heaped with green leafy vegetables and white-stemmed bok choy. Cell 1 (left) = rest: she holds the basket with both hands at waist height in front of her, looking down at the greens. Cell 2 (middle) = offering: she leans slightly forward and stretches both arms out toward the left, basket at chest height, smiling, offering it to a passer-by. Cell 3 (right) = showing: the basket rests on her left forearm at waist height and her right hand lifts one bunch of bok choy toward the left to show it. The feet stay planted on exactly the same spot in all three cells; only the arms, hands, heads and upper bodies move, with believable weight at the hips and knees. Fine ink outlines and muted antique Chinese watercolor exactly matching the first reference, same line weight, same palette, same paper-grain shading. Truly transparent alpha background, no ground shadow, no glow, no grid lines, no numbers, no text. One single horizontal row of 3 equal-width cells, one full group per cell, centered in its cell with generous margin so hands, baskets, scrolls, sleeves and feet never touch a cell edge. Identical character size and identical camera angle in every cell. Redraw at higher detail than the small reference without changing the design. Make every cell match the first reference and match each other as strictly as possible.
